zh.title: 美國參議員敦促達美航空在空服員籌組工會事宜保持中立
zh.summary: 美國聯邦參議員敦促達美航空執行長，在空服員籌組工會期間保持中立。
body: 美國多位聯邦參議員日前向達美航空（Delta Air Lines）提出呼籲，要求該公司在空服員籌組工會的過程中保持中立立場。參議員們向達美航空執行長施壓，要求管理階層在空服員推動工會組織的相關活動中採行不干涉的態度。
此一呼籲背景源於達美航空空服員指控管理階層針對其籌組工會的努力進行打壓與抵制。聯邦參議員對此要求達美航空管理團隊尊重員工權益，讓空服員能夠在不受管理階層干涉的情況下自主決定工會代表事宜。

en.title: US Senators Urge Delta Air Lines To Remain Neutral On Flight Attendant Union Drive
en.summary: US Senators press Delta Air Lines executive management to stay neutral on flight attendant union drive.
body: Members of the United States Senate have urged Delta Air Lines to maintain a neutral position regarding current union organizing efforts among its flight attendants. The senators pressed the chief executive officer of Delta Air Lines to adopt a hands-off approach throughout the flight attendant unionization process.

The call from United States lawmakers comes after Delta Air Lines flight attendants alleged that they experienced managerial pushback while conducting organizing efforts. The senators stated that management at Delta Air Lines should allow flight attendants to determine their union representation without opposition or interference from executive leadership.

zh.title: 英國民航局警告雷射攻擊救護直升機恐釀重大事故
zh.summary: 英國民航局警告雷射攻擊救護直升機恐釀災難；最重判刑五年
body: 英國民航局（CAA）警告，以雷射攻擊空中救護直升機可能導致「災難性事故」，涉案者恐面臨五年有期徒刑。
英國民航局於2026年9月10日的英國空中救護週期間，與慈善機構Air Ambulances UK共同說明此風險。
英國民航局表示，雷射攻擊每月都會發生，可能導致飛行員暫時失明、分心，甚至造成長期眼睛傷害。
英國緊急空中救護每天飛行超過135架次。2025年共有94起緊急直升機遭攻擊案例，2026年上半年則有35起。
英國民航局飛行營運主管葛倫·布萊德利（Glenn Bradley）表示，這些攻擊必須停止。

en.title: UK CAA warns laser attacks on air ambulances could cause catastrophic incident
en.summary: CAA warns lasers on air ambulances could cause catastrophe, risking 5-year jail terms
body: The UK Civil Aviation Authority (CAA) has warned that targeting air ambulances with lasers could cause a “catastrophic incident” and result in offenders facing a five-year prison sentence.
On September 10, 2026, during UK Air Ambulance Week, the CAA, in tandem with the charity Air Ambulances UK, spoke about the dangers that critical care helicopters are facing from the ground.
According to the CAA, laser attacks occur every month and can cause temporary blindness and distraction to pilots, or even long-term eye damage.
Emergency air ambulances fly over 135 flights a day in the UK. During 2025, there were 94 cases of emergency helicopters being attacked. For the first half of 2026, the total is 35.
Glenn Bradley, Head of Flight Operations at the UK CAA, said these attacks need to stop.
